verdict.rationale: Ardent makes database delegation safe through isolation rather than through scoped SQL tools. The agent receives only a branch URL, needs no Ardent token, and "can't touch anything but its branch" (ardent-docs-18, ardent-docs-24), which lets destructive operations run against a production copy (ardent-docs-21, ardent-docs-2). The only read-only versus destructive distinctions are on the control plane: a read-only `role_org_viewer` API role (ardent-docs-15) and a connector deletion lock (ardent-docs-16). Missing for 10: agent-facing SQL and schema tools (e.g., an MCP server), tool-level scoping that separates read-only from destructive SQL, per-operation permission or approval gates, and independent corroboration.
